title: GTA 6 Selfridges London Takeover Features £2,500 Varsity Jacket
description: London luxury department store Selfridges launches a massive GTA 6 takeover on Oxford Street, featuring exclusive clothing including a £2,500 varsity jacket.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Takes Over Selfridges in London with Exclusive $2,500 Varsity Jacket

As anticipation continues to build for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, the marketing machine behind Grand Theft Auto 6 is expanding into high-end fashion. According to a recent report by gaming outlet Eurogamer, prestigious British department store Selfridges has launched a massive GTA 6 takeover in London.

### Oxford Street Corner Shop Transformed

The upscale retailer has completely overhauled its iconic Corner Shop store located on Oxford Street in London. The dramatic makeover immerses visitors into the distinct visual style associated with the franchise, creating a striking physical presence for the game in one of London's busiest shopping districts.

### Exclusive Clothing Line and Premium Pricing

Alongside the store transformation, Selfridges has introduced a considerable line of official clothing inspired by Grand Theft Auto 6. While the collection features various items catering to fans, one particular piece has dominated the conversation: an exclusive varsity jacket priced at an eye-watering £2,500.

For fans who cannot make it to the physical London location to check out the storefront and merchandise in person, the retailer has confirmed that the GTA 6 collection is also available to purchase online through the Selfridges website.

## Editor's Take

This high-end retail collaboration between Selfridges and GTA 6 highlights the massive cultural footprint of the franchise. While a £2,500 varsity jacket is undeniably steep and clearly aimed at ultra-dedicated collectors or fashion enthusiasts, the ambitious storefront takeover successfully bridges the gap between gaming culture and luxury retail, generating significant mainstream buzz.
